text:
emma: quick proposal for enterprise retention defaults + BYOK access flow. goal: simple defaults but clear upgrade/forensics path for SOC2/ISO customers. want objections before i put in roadmap.

emma: proposed retention tiers:
- Bronze (default, no extra charge): hot 30d, cold 365d (auto-archive)
- Silver (mid): hot 180d, cold 540d (18mo)
- Gold (premium): hot 730d (2y) full hot, export SLA + SLA credits

raj: thumbs up on tiers. a couple of musts: (1) for SOC2/ISO we need WORM/immutability option and legal-hold must supersede lifecycle, (2) sampling/trimming cannot apply to enterprise contracts unless customer opts in.

nora: security notes: if tenant picks BYOK for logs then: keys must be HSM-backed, we store only key metadata, and key-escrow path must be documented. emergency unseal requires 2-person approval (security lead + legal) & an auditable ticket. also require signed manifests (SHA256) for all exported snapshots.

sam: ops concerns: migrating current customers -> we should default to Bronze and offer a 60d opt-in window to choose Silver/Gold. migration runbook draft: announcement -> telemetry window 14d -> opt-in form -> backfill job (rate limited) -> post-checks (counts/hash). Canary on 3 tenants first.

emma: acceptance criteria idea (product):
- E2E export (legalhold) with signed manifest and immutability flag tested
- BYOK handshake + escrow flow documented and smoke-tested
- Console shows retention tier, projected monthly delta, and "change cost" CTA
- Billing emits metrics: ["audit_log_bytes_ingested", "audit_retention_tier", "audit_export_bytes"]
- Search SLA: hot tier p95 < 200ms, exports complete within agreed SLA for Gold

raj: config sketch (infra):
```json
{
  "retention_policy": {
    "default_tier": "bronze",
    "tiers": {
      "bronze": {"hot_days": 30, "cold_days": 365},
      "silver": {"hot_days": 180, "cold_days": 540},
      "gold": {"hot_days": 730, "cold_days": 0}
    }
  },
  "byok": {"hsm_required": true, "escrow_enabled": true, "emergency_unseal": "2_person_approval"},
  "legal_hold": {"overrides_retention": true, "immutable_export": true}
}
```

lisa-legal-bot: note: any retention change impacting evidence availability must be disclosed in customer contracts. subpoenas/forensics requests -> route to legal + 72hr SLAs for acknowledge.

nora: also add: evidence manifests must be signed by an internal signing key and include timezone-normalized timestamps + SHA256 checksums. store manifest in immutable-backed bucket.

sam: ops TODOs from this thread:
- instrument billing counters (audit_log_bytes_ingested, audit_retention_tier)
- implement lifecycle job for tier transitions with safe backfill mode
- build canary pipeline (3 pilot tenants) + rollback switch
- expose per-tenant cost projection API for Console

emma: product TODOs:
- finalize tier pricing and SLA language (with finance)
- write Console copy + CTA for upgrade + one-pager for sales
- define gating for GA: compliance matrix green, canary success, billing metrics visible

raj: sales ask: we should offer a "forensics add-on" for Gold that includes 24/7 on-call forensic unwrap for BYOK (chargeable hourly) and a signed chain-of-custody package. will need a short blurb.

emma: will draft blurb + one-pager. can we get security to draft the emergency-unseal playbook this week?

nora: i can draft the playbook and the signed-manifest spec by Fri.

emma: great. scheduling a 30min sync to finalize numbers Tue 11am UTC. :calendar:

lisa-legal-bot: reminder: create contract amendment template if tier defaults change.

emma: thanks folks. i'll open a tracker ticket with the acceptance criteria and tag security/ops/legal. :thumbsup:
